correctness.rationale: Exchangeability without ties gives a uniform rank permutation. Before the triple, a record indicator is independent by disjointness; after the triple, the last insertion rank is uniform conditional on the relative order of the preceding prefix. This is the precise conditioning for the proof's independence step. For a triple centered at i, put L=i−2. Conditional on its pattern, a triple member of rank b can be a record only if it is an internal left-to-right maximum. Given this condition it is a record with probability binom(L+b−1,b−1)/binom(L+3,3), by interleaving the three sorted triple members with the L sorted earlier observations. Multiplying by 1/6 and subtracting the marginal product gives the displayed local vector divided by 6i(i−1)(i+1), including i=2. For a local numerator ai+b let A=(a+b)/2 and C=(b−a)/2. Summing the corresponding partial fractions gives six times the covariance as A−C/2−A/(n−1)+C/n, which yields all six formulas and their signs and limits. The inspected verifier was not executed; its stated finite checks are not needed for this exact argument.
